text: 30 years in Rossmoor I have dedicated myself to our community on many levels.

I am married with one daughter and she was the motivation for my working to preserve and engage in our beautiful community. I spent 9 years on the St. Hedwig School Board including serving as PTO President and the Autumfest Executive and Church Boards. We moved to Los Al High School and I served on several Boards, including the PTA, and as Booster President notably. I also served on Los Alamitos Chamber Board of Directors and the Rossmoor Homeowners Assoc .Board of Directors, I can say I am the only current Director that has served on both the RHA and RCSD, and I am a member of the Rossmoor Women's Club. I only have the interest of our community at heart and serve diligently. You will find me at our local meetings and events for Rossmoor, Los Alamitos City and School District, supporting all and staying informed on all levels to ensure Rossmoor continues the excellence level we are accustomed to. I wish to continue my service on the RCSD Board of Directors.

text: As a Board Member for the Rossmoor Community Services District Board, I bring experienced, accountable, and transparent leadership that puts our residents first.

With 32 years of experience in local government, I have worked successfully with county departments and other public agencies to deliver effective solutions through strong intergovernmental cooperation. My background in public works operations includes,

Parks
Urban Forestry
Street Sweeping
Solid Waste and Recycling
Budget Administration
Grant Management
Giving Rossmoor the practical experience needed to oversee essential community services.

I will work to improve transparency, strengthen communication between the Rossmoor Community Services District Board and residents, and ensure that decisions are made openly and with meaningful public input.

I believe every tax dollar should be spent responsibly and efficiently. I will promote sound financial management, careful budgeting, and cost-effective solutions that protect our community while maintaining the high level of services Rossmoor residents expect.

I am also committed to expanding community involvement by working cooperatively with the Rossmoor Homeowners Association, local schools, youth sports organizations, and other community partners. Together, we can preserve Rossmoor's outstanding quality of life, strengthen community relationships, and ensure our district remains a safe, attractive, and well-managed place to live for generations to come.

text: I am committed to preserving Rossmoor's outstanding quality of life through thoughtful, ethical, and fiscally responsible leadership. I hold a Doctor of Education from North Carolina State University and have more than 35 years of experience in education, public service, program administration, policy development, and organizational leadership.

As a faculty member at Point Loma Nazarene University and former consultant to the American Association of Family and Consumer Sciences, I have worked extensively in budgeting, governance, strategic planning, and collaborative problem-solving. Throughout my career, I have built consensus, developed public policy, and led organizations at the local, state, and national levels.

My community service includes leadership with the Los Alamitos Unified School District PTA Council, Orange County PTA, the Rossmoor Homeowners Association, and local bicycle safety initiatives. I authored the Rossmoor Homeowners Association's resolution supporting safe and responsible e-bike use and have advocated for neighborhood safety, youth well-being, and strong public schools.

If elected, I will listen carefully to residents, make informed decisions based on facts, encourage transparency and fiscal responsibility, and work collaboratively to protect Rossmoor's parks, services, safety, and unique community character.
I respectfully ask for your vote.
